title: "Dashboard DAES: Plan de Trabajo (2026-0 y 2026-1)"
format:
  dashboard:
    scrolling: true
    theme: cosmo
server: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
library(googlesheets4)
library(plotly)
library(scales)

gs4_deauth()

url_sheet <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DVB1HMDZxHc2tKNUde61sLnGmHEjWxGKZQo34iNfGlw/edit?usp=sharing"

datos <- tryCatch(
  read_sheet(url_sheet, sheet = "General"),
  error = function(e) { message("Error: ", e$message); NULL }
)

# Aplanar list-cols numéricas del setup
if (!is.null(datos)) {
  rdatos <- datos %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ {
      v <- sapply(., function(x) if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x[[1]]))
      v
    }))
} else {
  rdatos <- tibble()
}

# Renombrar oficinas
nombre_oficina <- c(
  "ApoyoSocial"    = "Apoyo y promoción social",
  "OIE"            = "Iniciativas Estudiantiles",
  "Prom_Bienestar" = "Promoción del Bienestar",
  "OBP"            = "OBP",
  "Becas"          = "Becas",
  "Deportes"       = "Deportes",
  "Empleabilidad"  = "Empleabilidad",
  "Salud"          = "Salud"
)

if (nrow(rdatos) > 0 && "Oficina" %in% names(rdatos)) {
  rdatos <- rdatos %>% mutate(Oficina = recode(Oficina, !!!nombre_oficina))
}

color_semaforo <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(x < 70 ~ "#E74C3C", x < 100 ~ "#F39C12", TRUE ~ "#27AE60")
}

colores_estado <- c(
  "FINALIZADO"    = "#27AE60",
  "EN DESARROLLO" = "#2980B9",
  "NO EJECUTADO"  = "#E74C3C",
  "REPROGRAMADO"  = "#F39C12"
)

safe_chr <- function(col) {
  sapply(col, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) NA_character_
    else as.character(x[[1]])
  })
}

safe_num <- function(col) {
  sapply(col, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) NA_real_
    else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[[1]]))
  })
}
```

```{r ui-sidebar}
selectInput("oficina", tags$b("Oficina"), choices = NULL)
selectInput("ciclo",   tags$b("Ciclo"),   choices = c("2026-0", "2026-1"), selected = "2026-0")
uiOutput("tarjeta_metas")
```

```{r server}
#| context: server

# ── Llenar selector ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
observe({
  req(nrow(rdatos) > 0)
  oficinas <- sort(unique(rdatos$Oficina))
  updateSelectInput(session, "oficina", choices = oficinas, selected = oficinas[1])
})

# ── Reactivo base ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
datos_reactivo <- reactive({
  req(input$oficina, input$ciclo, nrow(rdatos) > 0)

  df <- rdatos %>% filter(Oficina == input$oficina, Ciclo == input$ciclo)

  if (input$ciclo == "2026-0") {
    df <- df %>% mutate(
      nivel_cumplimiento = safe_num(Nivel_Cumplimiento_20260) * 100,
      estado             = safe_chr(Estado_Termino_20260),
      ejecucion          = safe_num(Ejecucion_Termino_20260)
    )
  } else {
    df <- df %>% mutate(
      nivel_cumplimiento = safe_num(Nivel_Cumplimiento_PrimerCorte_20261) * 100,
      estado             = safe_chr(Estado_PrimerCorte_20261),
      ejecucion          = safe_num(Ejecucion_PrimerCorte_20261)
    )
  }
  df
})

# ── Tarjeta metas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$tarjeta_metas <- renderUI({
  tot <- nrow(datos_reactivo())
  div(
    style = paste0(
      "margin-top:20px;padding:18px 12px;border-radius:10px;",
      "background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A5276,#2E86C1);",
      "color:white;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25);"
    ),
    div(style = "font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;opacity:.85;margin-bottom:4px;", "TOTAL DE METAS"),
    div(style = "font-size:52px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;", tot),
    div(style = "font-size:12px;opacity:.75;margin-top:4px;", paste("Ciclo", input$ciclo))
  )
})

# ── G1: Metas por tipo de actividad ─────────────────────────────────────────
output$g1_tipo <- renderPlotly({
  df <- datos_reactivo()
  req(nrow(df) > 0, "Tipo_Actividad" %in% names(df))

  conteo <- df %>%
    count(Tipo_Actividad, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(Tipo_Actividad = fct_reorder(Tipo_Actividad, n, .desc = TRUE))

  plot_ly(conteo, x = ~Tipo_Actividad, y = ~n, type = "bar",
          marker = list(color = "#0d2251", line = list(color = "#0d2251", width = 1.2)),
          text = ~n, textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>Metas: %{y}<extra></extra>") %>%
    layout(xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -30, automargin = TRUE),
           yaxis  = list(title = "Cantidad de metas"),
           margin = list(t = 30, b = 80),
           plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)") %>%
    config(responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = FALSE)
})

# ── G2: Cumplimiento promedio por tipo ───────────────────────────────────────
output$g2_cumplimiento <- renderPlotly({
  df <- datos_reactivo()
  req(nrow(df) > 0, "Tipo_Actividad" %in% names(df))

  prom <- df %>%
    group_by(Tipo_Actividad) %>%
    summarise(prom_nivel = mean(nivel_cumplimiento, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(prom_nivel)) %>%
    mutate(Tipo_Actividad = fct_reorder(Tipo_Actividad, prom_nivel, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(prom_nivel)) %>%
    mutate(
      color = color_semaforo(prom_nivel),
      label = paste0(round(prom_nivel, 1), "%")
    )

  req(nrow(prom) > 0)

  plot_ly(prom, x = ~Tipo_Actividad, y = ~prom_nivel, type = "bar",
          marker = list(color = ~color, line = list(color = "rgba(0,0,0,.15)", width = 1)),
          text = ~label, textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>Cumplimiento: %{text}<extra></extra>") %>%
    layout(xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -30, automargin = TRUE, type = "category"),
           yaxis  = list(title = "Cumplimiento promedio (%)", range = c(0, 160)),
           shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = -0.5, x1 = nrow(prom) - 0.5,
                              y0 = 100, y1 = 100,
                              line = list(color = "grey", width = 1.5, dash = "dot"))),
           margin = list(t = 30, b = 80),
           plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)") %>%
    config(responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = FALSE)
})

# ── G3: Público objetivo (barras horizontales) ───────────────────────────────
output$g3_publico <- renderPlotly({
  df <- datos_reactivo()
  req(nrow(df) > 0, "Publico_Objetivo" %in% names(df))

  conteo <- df %>%
    count(Publico_Objetivo, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(etiqueta = str_trunc(Publico_Objetivo, width = 45, ellipsis = "..."))

  plot_ly(conteo,
          x = ~n, y = ~reorder(etiqueta, n),
          type        = "bar",
          orientation = "h",
          marker      = list(color = "#2E86C1", line = list(color = "#1A5276", width = 1)),
          text        = ~n, textposition = "outside",
          hovertext   = ~Publico_Objetivo,
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{hovertext}</b><br>Metas: %{x}<extra></extra>") %>%
    layout(xaxis  = list(title = "Cantidad de metas"),
           yaxis  = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE),
           margin = list(l = 20, r = 50, t = 30, b = 40),
           plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)") %>%
    config(responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = FALSE)
})

# ── G5: Metas por estado ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$g5_estado <- renderPlotly({
  df <- datos_reactivo()
  req(nrow(df) > 0)

  conteo <- df %>%
    mutate(estado = toupper(trimws(estado))) %>%
    count(estado, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(color = case_when(
      estado == "FINALIZADO"    ~ colores_estado["FINALIZADO"],
      estado == "EN DESARROLLO" ~ colores_estado["EN DESARROLLO"],
      estado == "NO EJECUTADO"  ~ colores_estado["NO EJECUTADO"],
      estado == "REPROGRAMADO"  ~ colores_estado["REPROGRAMADO"],
      TRUE ~ "#95A5A6"
    ))

  plot_ly(conteo, x = ~estado, y = ~n, type = "bar",
          marker = list(color = ~color, line = list(color = "rgba(0,0,0,.15)", width = 1)),
          text = ~n, textposition = "outside",
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>Metas: %{y}<extra></extra>") %>%
    layout(xaxis  = list(title = "", type = "category", automargin = TRUE, tickangle = -20),
           yaxis  = list(title = "Cantidad de metas"),
           margin = list(t = 30, b = 80),
           plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)") %>%
    config(responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = FALSE)
})

# ── G4: Gauge de cumplimiento general ────────────────────────────────────────
output$g4_gauge <- renderPlotly({
  df  <- datos_reactivo()
  req(nrow(df) > 0)

  val         <- round(mean(df$nivel_cumplimiento, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  color_aguja <- color_semaforo(val)

  plot_ly(type = "indicator", mode = "gauge+number+delta", value = val,
          number = list(suffix = "%", font = list(size = 46, color = color_aguja)),
          delta  = list(reference = 100,
                        increasing = list(color = "#27AE60"),
                        decreasing = list(color = "#E74C3C"),
                        suffix = "%"),
          gauge  = list(
            axis      = list(range = list(0, 150), tickmode = "linear",
                             dtick = 25, ticksuffix = "%"),
            bar       = list(color = color_aguja, thickness = 0.25),
            steps     = list(
              list(range = c(0,   70),  color = "#FADBD8"),
              list(range = c(70,  100), color = "#FDEBD0"),
              list(range = c(100, 150), color = "#D5F5E3")
            ),
            threshold   = list(line = list(color = "#566573", width = 3), value = 100),
            bgcolor     = "white", borderwidth = 1, bordercolor = "#D5D8DC"
          )) %>%
    layout(margin = list(l = 30, r = 30, t = 60, b = 20),
           plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)") %>%
    config(responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = FALSE)
})

```
